title: The name on every quote that leaves this desk
caption: Jordan Yates - matching travellers with the right ships since 2011.
brief: Jordan's engraved portrait stamp, centred on white - composed 4:5 from public/portrait-engraved.png.

text: Behind BON V is one advisor, not an agency floor.
sub: You write to me, you book with me, and when something needs fixing mid-trip it's still me. The number on the site rings at this desk.

items.head: Cruise, only
items.body: Ocean, river and expedition. Ships are the whole business at this desk.

items.head: A Virtuoso practice
items.body: Run in partnership with Luxury Cruise Connections, which is where the negotiated fares come from.

items.head: At this since 2011
items.body: Fifteen years of sailings, ship visits and kept notes. The notes matter most.

quote: Honest counsel on ships, seasons and itineraries - including which celebrated ones to skip.

text: You bring the leaning. I come back with three worth your time.
sub: Each one comes with the reason it made the cut and a fare I've negotiated myself. My clients never pay retail.

title: Tell me where you're leaning
body: A region, a month, even just a ship somebody mentioned at dinner. Write or send a DM and I'll come back with a shortlist worth your time.
